title: Moderation
description: Every new listing and every edit waits here. What is already public stays unchanged until the decision.

decided.approved: Approved. The new version is public.
decided.rejected: Rejected. The business has received the reason.

empty.pendingBody: New listings and edits appear here, oldest first.

target.title: Service target
target.body: Within how many hours a submission should be decided. The queue marks what has passed the target.
target.label: Hours

detail.title: Submission for moderation
detail.liveStays: The public version stays unchanged until you decide.
detail.noChanges: No difference from the public version.
detail.reject: Reject — it stays as it was
detail.reasonHint: Required when rejecting. The business sees it in the app and receives it by email: say what needs fixing.
detail.immutable: A recorded decision cannot be changed. The business can send a new version.

blocked.ownBusinessBody: You are on this business's team. The decision must be taken by a moderator unconnected to it.
blocked.ownSubmissionBody: You created it. A second person must check it.
blocked.notModeratorTitle: Only a listing moderator can decide
blocked.notModeratorBody: You can see the submission, but the decision belongs to the listing moderator role.

reasonHint: The business sees it in the app and receives it by email. At least 10 characters.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: The status of each business. A restriction or suspension is applied from the business's page, with the reason recorded.
businesses.name: Name
businesses.unclaimedBody: Added by EventDesk from public sources. They do not belong to a business yet.

status.title: Status and restrictions
status.body: Restricted: listings stay public, the business can no longer add or change anything. Suspended: listings no longer appear. The reason stays on record and is shown to the business.
status.saved: The status has been applied. The business has been notified.

badges.title: Verified facts
badges.body: Only these two statements can appear on a listing. Each check is free and stays on record: who, when, what was seen.
badges.seenOnrcHint: For example: ONRC extract, its number and date, the matching name.
badges.seenInsuranceHint: For example: the insurer, the policy number, the type of cover.
badges.moderatorOnly: Checks are recorded by a listing moderator.

directory.title: Directory
directory.description: The categories, counties and localities businesses choose from, the public pages and the directory statistics.
directory.mergeCategoryHint: Listings in this category move to the chosen one; this one is retired.
directory.mergeLocalityHint: Listings stay attached: they move to the chosen locality; this one is retired.
directory.mergeCountyHint: Localities and listings move to the chosen county; this one is retired.
directory.categoriesBody: The order here is the order in the directory and in forms. A retired category can no longer be chosen, but stays on the listings that have it.
directory.codeHint: One to three letters, for example CJ.
directory.localitiesBody: A locality gets its own public page only where there are enough businesses.
directory.searchesNote: daily totals, with no visitor identifier of any kind
directory.statsBody: How many searches each pair had and how many live listings it has.
directory.statsEmpty: No search and no live listing yet

errors.reasonRequired: Write the reason that will be given to the business (at least 10 characters).
errors.alreadyDecided: This submission has already been decided or withdrawn.
errors.ownBusiness: You are on this business's team: another moderator must decide.
errors.ownSubmission: You created this submission: a second person must decide.
errors.notModerator: Only a listing moderator can decide.
errors.seenRequired: Write what you saw during the check (at least 5 characters).
errors.noOnrcNumber: The business has not stated an ONRC number: there is nothing to check.
errors.insuranceExpired: The validity date is in the past.
errors.mergeSame: Choose a different entry from the one you are merging.
errors.mergeIntoRetired: You cannot merge into a retired entry.
errors.codeTaken: A county with this code already exists.
errors.localityExists: A locality with this name already exists in the county.
